dedupe_keys.name: foca italian flood and catchment atlas

description: Politecnico di Torino publishes FOCA, the Italian Flood and Catchment Atlas, for river catchments with historical discharge observations. Hydrometric information includes annual maximum peak discharge and annual maxima of mean daily discharge. Catchment descriptors cover geomorphology, climate, extreme rainfall, land cover and soils. The inspected concept address resolves to version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.11217292. Zenodo supplies the FOCA ZIP and supporting documentation with open, free access under CC-BY-4.0. Exact time coverage and internal table formats were not established from the landing metadata. A limitation is that catchments have different observation histories, so comparisons require completeness and station checks. The atlas could support regional flood-frequency estimation and calibration of catchment models for flood-defence assessment. It complements gridded rainfall products by connecting extreme-flow observations with catchment characteristics. An earlier repository version is treated as the same resource, and neither the dataset nor supporting PDF was downloaded.
